title: v0.1.1 — unsigned Windows portable preview and CLI tarball published
summary: GitHub release v0.1.1 publishes an unsigned Windows x64 portable preview (ZIP plus SHA256SUMS) and attaches an npm-format CLI tarball for transparency. Nothing is published to the npm registry, and no Setup.exe is attached; the supported install path remains clone + build.

title: Tag-triggered Windows portable bundle workflow merged (PR #312)
summary: CI builds the unsigned Windows portable bundle for v* tags and opens a draft release; publishing is a separate owner action. This milestone alone publishes nothing.

title: Installer lifecycle qualification merged (PR #313)
summary: An NSIS per-user Setup.exe builder and lifecycle harness land in CI. No Setup.exe is attached to published releases; the published preview is the portable ZIP, and no code signing exists.

title: Windows runtime and first-launch packaging merged (PR #306)
summary: Desktop packaging work landed on main as a source milestone: at that point no public Desktop download or installer qualification existed yet. The v0.1.1 release later published an unsigned portable preview; installer qualification remains unpublished.

title: v0.1.0 — first public pre-1.0 source release
summary: First public source tag of Babel. The release tag carries no downloadable assets; install remains clone + build.
